summary: Practise ISO-based records controls, evidence testing, retention decisions, and reporting. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: ISO records management training is for records, compliance, audit, and process professionals who assess records controls across the lifecycle. Participants practise mapping capture, access, retention, and disposition controls, checking metadata quality and sample-testing records, and documenting evidence gaps with corrective actions. They also use exception logs and prepare management reports for operational review.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who set, operate, test, or rely on records controls in digital and paper-based processes. It is designed for intermediate-level learners with experience in records, compliance, audit, or operational documentation.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of records handling, document control, compliance, audit, or operational documentation is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
